active_catalog_context.role: Comparison context only; not the observation source, selection, or approval.

count_policy: Unique positive numeric GitHub repository IDs within this observation snapshot. Query occurrences overlap. Candidates may overlap active catalog resources; these populations must not be added or treated as independent projects.

privacy.policy: Only allowlisted public repository fields and accepted primary receipts. Suspect descriptions are explicitly omitted; owner/contact objects, headers, raw bodies and local paths are not exported.

review_policy: Public GitHub metadata observations only. Every row remains candidate/relevance_pending; HTTP success, a topic tag, or a repository name does not establish CUA relevance, release completeness, licensing, or editorial approval.

scan.limit: Bounded observed requests, not an exhaustive GitHub/CUA census. Per-query totals and overlapping shards are not a global union.
